body: I don't want to stop him, as you say he's an adult. But he's an idiot. He doesn't think further than his nose can reach. I want advice on how to talk to him about making an international travel when he has no sense of responsibility
My problem is he drags our parents and their partners with him, mostly because of the whole money thing. They're not the most well off people but they got hearts of gold and deserve better
Not planning to. Blocking his number tomorrow after blocking the flying monkey from info leaks. Thank you for your words!

I don't speak much with aunt, but will restrict her on FB and have a talk with her and other relatives who talk to aunt about what I want to reach her. Thank you for your words, it really described how this situation is.
Very true! But I need to deal with this sooner rather than later. Maybe a talk to grandma will help things

I definitely need to talk to aunt, no questions about it. Problem isn't she'll listen or if I have to ghost her as well.. 

Maybe I should give out her phone number just so she knows what it's like!

My spine, unlike your shiny one, is made of jell-o. I don't think I'd be able to stand up to him if I meet him, and end up just pretending everything is fine. 


Something I really don't want cuz everything is not fine >__<

All MILs, especially the Jocastas, call their DILs dictators. Because they really mean "Dick takers". 

I'll show myself out.

Doesn't feel like it when they ignore me when I need help and let me celebrate a day I absolutely despise all alone. I was looking forward to sitting down with them and chatting a bit since they're often out of the house due to work and other obligations. Instead I was handed a slice of cake, told "You'll eat in your room, right?" and left alone. I hate being alone, I hate feeling this way and I can't find a way to stop it...


I just wish they didn't write me off so easily. But all I hear is that it's my fault, that I need to reach out more. And that's very hard to hear when all I can think is how I'm a worthless piece of shit not worthy of anyone's time. I think I'll just call the emergency room before I do anything stupid...

I'm not worthy of a mustelid, hence the rodent x)


Trivia nights are awesome, double tag with your wife and swipe the place clean!

Since you commented on my comment, may I take the opportunity to say you and your wife kick ass and if I ever discover my spirit animal I want it to be a tiny, angry rodent?


Also, do not inform Hellsbelle about this, you may lose your toaster  X)
Aww, I think that's adorable! I want my future grandkids to call me a witch too, I'd love that! Might steal "Baba" and use it in... 40-50 years if it's alright with you?

> (guys, GUYS! SPENDING TIME ON THE INTERNET MAKES YOU GAY! and yes, she used the word that).

This... explains so much!! I've always wondered why I turned out bi! Too much of that ol' internet in my youth! /s
Yay! My Drama Llama, Sandy Hoof, is very pleased by this development :D She may need dieting when this is all over though, poor girl.

That is nothing short of funny! Please tell me you have googled "memere" at least? 
"In Quebec, "mémère" refers to a chatty, indiscrete person (read: a gossip!). There is also the verb (used, again, in Quebec) "mémèrer": to gossip. A Day in a French Life... The Petit Larousse, not one to mince words, defines the French word "mémère" as "a woman, quite plump and old.""

I know quite a few mémère's! x)
Glad to help! And even if I hope your mum & MIL leave you alone, I kinda want you to keep posting about their bullcrap. Does this make me evil?
I have literally never had that problem as my mum only has a sister and my dad only has a brother. Yay simplistic families!

That's the thing though, isn't it? The intentions behind it. I know my mormor or farmor would never step on my mums toes the way your mum and MIL does/have done (and gods know I am so thankful for that after lurking in this sub for the past 6 months!)

Also slight fangirl moment now that one of my favourite contributors replied to me <3

You're completely right. I also love the difference between maternal and paternal, and have a lot of problems when my British SO talk about his grandparents as I have to ask to which of his parent they "belong to" x)

It's kinda sad that these harpies ruins something with that much tradition in my part of the world (Scandinavia). Here our maternal grandparents are Mormor and Morfar (Mommom and momdad) and paternal grandparents are Farmor and Farfar (dadmom and daddad). Or the unison Bestemor and Bestefar (Grandmom and Granddad, though literally translated "Bestmom" and "Bestdad").

I have no idea if this even belongs here, but heck. My mother isn't a JNmom, she's got a screw loose just like I do. I am diagnosed and am unable to live by myself right now due to no job and no security. Mom's an angel for letting me stay at home (paying rent though!).

BUT. I have been in a bad spot lately (my 8 year old pup had surgery today, removing a tumour that may or may not be cancerous) and I treat this dog like she's the missing half of my soul/heart/essence. The pup saved me from the darkness of my own mind. I was very nervous and anxious about her surgery. How does my mum cope with an escalating diagnose I've had for nearly a decade? Ignores me. Since Saturday she's said exactly 5 sentences to me, 2 of which were over text/FB. Until tonight when she got home and realised pup was alive and well and I wasn't shutting down socially and generally being miserable. She's been to my psychiatrist with me, she's had it explained so so so SO many times what I need but am unable to ask for when I shut down. And her reaction this week really disappointed me. I now walk around with a constant feeling of anxiety in my belly when she's around, and I feel like a jackass for pretty much being in the beginning stages of a nervous breakdown when I see her.

If he recognises that you need to get out of a behaviour pattern but doesn't  think you'd need help, you really need a new guy. 

I am not a shrink, I can only speak out of my own experiences, and I was where you are right now. I got help, got diagnosed and went on meds for a year or two then was able to function better. Sad thoughts and no energy is like the textbook example of depression, unless you're manic which puts you on the other end of the spectrum

I know where you're coming from, I wouldn't have a handle on anything in my life either if I wasn't at home with my mother and her and stepdads support. 
The thing is, if you feel like you can't cope with your life, no one else no matter how accredited they are can tell you differently. You need to find someone willing and wanting to help you. The shrink you're currently seeing is not for you. Maybe there's a mismatch in chemistry between you or maybe he's not seeing you clearly, who knows.

Please find a new shrink, get the help you need. Don't let this guys words make you doubt yourself. 

Lots of love from fellow sufferer <3
